I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Cards and the win banner now respect reduced motion, including preference changes without reloading. Normal animations still work.

Build, 142 unit tests, and all motion checks pass. Browser suite: 78/79 passed; the documented artwork timeout passed with a longer limit. Changed files pass formatting; 13 pre-existing formatting issues remain. Verification is recorded in README.md.
